title: 流浪荒岛
description:
Thrilling battlesWandering Desert Island features powerful bosses, dangerous dungeons, and monsters spawning in different island biomes.
You can match weapons and equipment to unlock powerful skills to slash, block, tumble and destroy these monsters to survive!
Classic sandbox survival gameplayFarming and fishing, cutting down trees and digging for mines, building huts, these are all indispensable.
However, you don't need pickaxes and axes to sabotage here, an iron sword is enough.
Unlock and grow technologyTechnology changes lives, and with these technologies, you can upgrade your home. Expanded lighting, rapid watering, resource regeneration...
Explore the island and visit NPCsNot all islands are deserted, and some are inhabited by residents! Deal with the residents and trade goods with them.
Each island has unique creatures and resources to explore.
description_short: Wandering is a pixel-style sandbox action-adventure where you play as a drifting desert island adventurer trying to survive on a pristine desert island. You can explore unknown islands on a raft and get unique resources and treasures. Conquer powerful enemies and acquire rare equipment.
